title: migrate to SQLAlchemy async connection pool with PgBouncer
rationale: Replaces raw psycopg2 connection per request with async connection pool. Reduces connection pool exhaustion under 2,000 checkout req/sec.

title: Implement Exponential Backoff with Full Jitter for Stripe API
rationale: Adds decorator with decorator-level exponential backoff with full jitter (Decorrelated Jitter algorithm). Retries up to 4 times before failing.

title: Idempotency-Key Header Middleware with SHA-256 Request Hashing
rationale: Introduces Idempotency-Key HTTP header middleware computing SHA-256 digest of payload. Cache hit returns cached HTTP response immediately.

title: Migrate refund math to integer cents and Decimal representation
rationale: Converts all monetary fields to 64-bit integer minor currency units (cents) and Python Decimal to prevent floating point inaccuracies.

title: Reject fixed interval retries
rationale: Fixed 500ms sleep will create thundering herd when Stripe recovers. We must reject fixed sleep in favor of exponential backoff with randomized full jitter.

title: Reject database-level transaction locks for idempotency
rationale: Using row-level database locks (SELECT FOR UPDATE) on the checkout table creates bottleneck deadlock risks during sales. Redis key-value atomicity is required.

title: Reject skipping signature verification in development
rationale: Bypassing webhook signature checks via a debug flag risks shipping unverified endpoints to production. Verification must run in all environments with test keys.

title: Reject client-supplied refund timestamps
rationale: Relying on client timestamps allows fraudulent out-of-order refund attempts. Timestamps must strictly be generated by server UTC monotonic clock.

title: Reject caching unencrypted CVV in memory
rationale: Storing raw CVVs even temporarily in Redis or local process memory is a direct violation of PCI-DSS requirement 3.2. Prohibit all CVV persistence.

title: Add zalando/go-keyring provider for auth token persistence
rationale: Implements RFC 001. Migrates token storage to native OS keychain with graceful fallback to file store.

title: Batch repository and issue queries using GraphQL fragments
rationale: Implements RFC 002. Replaces REST loops with single paginated GraphQL queries fetching comments, reviews, and status rollups in one payload.

title: Fork-exec child subprocess isolation with restricted inherited env for extension
rationale: Implements RFC 003. Child process manager cleans up terminal modes on SIGINT/SIGTERM and restricts PATH lookup to extension directory.

title: Auto-detect TTY and disable ANSI formatting in non-interactive pipelines
rationale: Implements RFC 004. Replaces hardcoded escape codes with IOStreams ColorEnabled check and respects CLICOLOR / NO_COLOR standard env vars.

title: Implementation of gh auth git-credential helper protocol
rationale: Implements RFC 005. Configures git credential helper entry in global .gitconfig during gh auth login setup.

title: Reject custom symmetric encryption key on disk
rationale: Custom symmetric key encryption stored next to the ciphertext offers zero additional security. We must use OS-level protected credentials.

title: Reject executing third-party extensions via in-process Go plugins
rationale: Go dynamic plugin loading requires exact compiler and dependency ABI matches and allows arbitrary memory access. External subprocess isolation is non-negotiable.

title: Reject global auth token in HTTP GET query string
rationale: Passing tokens in URL query parameters exposes them in web server access logs and proxy history. All authentication must strictly use Authorization: Bearer HTTP header.

Consequences:

title: High guest exit latency on unpinned multi-threaded vCPUs
rationale: vCPU threads migrating across NUMA nodes caused up to 300% tail latency jitter on latency-sensitive guest workloads.

title: Implement VirtIO Memory Ballooning with Page Reporting
rationale: Adds virtio-balloon device supporting automatic unused page reporting back to host hypervisor. Enables dynamic RAM overcommit without guest performance degradation.

title: CPU Pinning and NUMA Topology Node Binding
rationale: Allows operator to pin guest vCPUs to specific host physical cores and bind guest RAM to local host NUMA nodes using libc::sched_setaffinity.

title: PCIe Root Port Hotplug Support for VirtIO Devices
rationale: Adds ACPI PCI hotplug notifications and PCIe native hotplug controller allowing runtime addition and removal of network interfaces and disks.

title: Asynchronous Disk I/O via Linux io_uring Engine
rationale: Replaces threadpool synchronous pread/pwrite with io_uring submission/completion queue rings for virtio-block backend.

title: Reject synchronous balloon deflation
rationale: Synchronous deflation blocks guest vCPUs for up to 400ms. We must reject synchronous balloon worker in favor of asynchronous background worker thread.

title: Reject legacy floppy and IDE device emulation
rationale: Emulating legacy PC hardware (floppy, IDE, PS/2) contradicts Cloud Hypervisor's minimal attack surface goal. Only modern VirtIO and PCIe interfaces will be supported.

title: Reject unbounded polling loops in vhost worker
rationale: Spin-polling io_uring SQPOLL thread pegging 100% CPU on idle guests is prohibited. Eventfd notification must be used when queue is drained.
